test_isolate_submodel_simple_capture: test isolate_submodel.call_and_extract_submodel to capture a simple pz.nn.Linear sublayer from an MLP model
test_isolate_submodel_with_states: test isolate_submodel.call_and_extract_submodel to capture a NamedGroup submodel with shared parameters, state variables, and random streams
test_isolated_submodel_replay: test replaying an isolated submodel using stateless_call with initial_var_values and saved_side_inputs
test_submodel_selection_at: test selecting a submodel via mlp.select().at with a lambda to target a specific nested layer
test_submodel_selection_at_subtrees_wher: test selecting a submodel via at_subtrees_where with a predicate matching pz.nn.NamedGroup by name
